l01: Adding a second language is easy. Living with it is the hard part.
l02: Keys instead of sentences, files to keep in sync, and glue for every framework.
l03: Meet Palamedes. Just write the sentence,
l04: and your app speaks every language your visitors do.
l05: One command collects every sentence into catalogs your translators already know.
l06: Your build turns them into tiny functions, and every screen loads only its own words.
l07: And your visitors simply read their language.
l08: The wiring for your framework is already built, and tested as real apps.
l09: Its Rust core keeps the tooling fast: seventy-three milliseconds for fifteen hundred files.
l11: Palamedes. Open source, at palamedes dot dev.
